text:
The diagram represents gas molecules contained in a cylinder. The piston is moved slowly
downwards and the temperature of the gas stays the same.
piston
cylinder
gas molecule
Why does the pressure of the gas increase?
A
The molecules collide harder with the walls.
B
The molecules collide more often with the walls.
C
The molecules move more quickly.
D
The number of molecules increases.

options.label: A
options.text: The molecules collide harder with the walls.

options.label: B
options.text: The molecules collide more often with the walls.
